title: The Library That Tried to Own Every Book
description: The Library of Alexandria and the legend of copying every scroll that came to town.

scenes.narration: This library tried to collect every book in the world.
scenes.image_prompt: grand ancient library hall with shelves of papyrus scrolls, columns, scholars reading

scenes.narration: It's around 250 BCE in Alexandria, Egypt. Greek kings called the Ptolemies are paying scholars to work here.
scenes.image_prompt: Hellenistic Alexandria harbour with lighthouse of Pharos, ships, white buildings

scenes.narration: Legend says ships arriving in the harbour are searched for books.
scenes.image_prompt: ancient guards inspecting a merchant ship's cargo of scrolls at a harbour dock

scenes.narration: The library keeps the originals, and gives the owners copies.
scenes.image_prompt: scribes copying papyrus scrolls at long tables, oil lamps, ancient Egypt

scenes.narration: Scholars here measure the Earth, study the stars and edit Homer.
scenes.image_prompt: ancient Greek scholar measuring shadows with a stick in the sun, diagrams in sand

scenes.narration: Its collection may have held tens or even hundreds of thousands of scrolls.
scenes.image_prompt: endless ancient shelves filled with scroll cases, light from high windows

scenes.narration: It wasn't destroyed in one great fire. It declined over centuries.
scenes.image_prompt: abandoned dusty ancient library hall with scattered scrolls, broken columns

scenes.narration: What lost book do you wish had survived? Comment below.
scenes.image_prompt: single ancient scroll on a stone table in a beam of light
